Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Dawn of Defiance (A Wretched Hive)

Darga the Hutt has many contacts on many worlds, but few are as unsavory as a band of slavers known as The Iron Ring. These slavers are small-time- at least, compared to some of the more dangerous slaving rings in the galaxy- but what they lack in influence, they make up for in zeal.

Most of The Iron Ring's jurisdiction is on former Confederate worlds ravaged by the Clone Wars, where the Empire's influence is minimal. Cato Neimoidia is one of their many planets of operation.

Iron Ring Nonheroic Units

See also: Nonheroic Units

NAME CHALLENGE LEVEL AFFILIATION NOTES
Dawn of Defiance
Wookiee Slaver CL 2 An exile from his homeworld of Kashyyyk, this slaver has abandoned the honor of his heritage and embraced a life of violence and destruction.
Twi'lek Poisoner CL 3 An agent of the slaver delegation that came to meet with Darga, this Twi'lek pretends to be a slave to better hide her true role.
